/* Listening Test 12 source-question compatibility */
#examQuestionHost .q-input-wrap{position:relative;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle}
#examQuestionHost .q-input-wrap>input.answer-input{text-align:center;padding:4px 8px;min-width:160px;width:160px}
#examQuestionHost .q-input-wrap::before{content:attr(data-qnum);position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;color:#111;font-size:.9em;pointer-events:none;opacity:.42}

#examQuestionHost .lmap-matrix th,#examQuestionHost .lmap-matrix td{border:1px solid #d9dde3;padding:8px;text-align:center;background:#fff}
#examQuestionHost .lmap-matrix th{background:#f1f2ec;font-weight:800}
#examQuestionHost .lmap-cell{display:block;cursor:pointer;padding:6px;border-radius:5px}
